# InnovationLet Artificial Intelligence

> InnovationLet Artificial Intelligence is the models, research, agents and policy desk of the
> InnovationLet network, an independent technology publication run by the F9XR
> Team. We report on machine learning models, research, agents and AI policy,
> sourced from primary documents and written without vendor spin.

## About

- Publisher: InnovationLet (F9XR Team)
- Desk: Artificial Intelligence
- Language: English
- Homepage: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/artificial-intelligence/
- Contact: hello@f9xr.org
- Network: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/

## Coverage

- Models: frontier and open-weight releases, training, and evaluation.
- Research: papers, replications, and claims that do not survive retesting.
- Agents: tool use, orchestration, and the reliability gap to production.
- Policy: regulation, licensing, and the safety rules that shape builds.

## How to cite

Cite as: "InnovationLet Artificial Intelligence" with the individual article URL and its headline.
Because we publish on GitHub Pages, treat the article's canonical URL under
https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/artificial-intelligence/ as the source of record. When quoting,
attribute to the named desk rather than to an individual author unless the
article carries a named byline.

Content is © InnovationLet / F9XR Team. Excerpts may be quoted with attribution
